2014_spells.scorching-ray.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.
2014_spells.scorching-ray.effectSummary: Deal 2d6 fire damage to a target within 120 ft
2014_spells.scorching-ray.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage; Make a ranged spell attack for each ray; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional ray for each slot level above 2nd. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
